note: Class names in templates/realtor/v1/master.css. Shown in the Brand Hub. Add a row here whenever a class is added to master.css.

items.name: btn-primary
items.does: Solid primary colour, turns accent on hover.

items.name: btn-accent
items.does: Solid accent colour, turns primary on hover.

items.name: btn-outline
items.does: See-through, thin primary border. Hover fills primary, text turns accent.

items.name: btn-accent-outline
items.does: See-through, thin accent border and accent text. Hover fills primary.

items.name: listing-bar
items.does: Listing strip: small location label, big accent address, white price.

items.name: spec-grid
items.does: Property Summary cards become clean columns with thin dividers.

items.name: site-footer
items.does: On the Footer section: links and icons turn accent on hover.

groups.name: Headings and text
groups.where: Put on the Heading or Paragraph element.

items.name: eyebrow
items.does: Small tracked-caps label above a heading.

items.name: accent-rule
items.does: Short accent line under a heading.

items.name: img-hover
items.does: Image zooms in slowly on hover.

items.name: lightbox
items.does: A single image opens full screen on click. Image Sliders do this already.

automatic: Headings, body text, bullets and in-text links take the brand fonts and colours.
The header (the section holding the menu) styles its menu links and Contact button itself.
Image Sliders open full screen on click.
Text pasted from REALTOR.ca is cleaned back to body style.
